summary: Tiny three-bay island at a busy junction, signed No Stopping, no room.
reasons: Three bays only, filled by cars
No Stopping Any Time signs beside it
Exposed junction among shops and homes

drivers.seclusion: Open island at a road junction; shops 29 m and homes 30 m away, all in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Three short bays hold three cars; no clear space for a van to pull fully in.
drivers.traffic: Junction of three roads, with traffic passing on every side.
drivers.convention: Two No Stopping Any Time signs sit beside the island, one 1.2 m away.

flags: Signs vs imagery: No Stopping signs next to a marked parking island
Cafe and shop frontage 29 m away
sun_shade: Open to the sky; a tree shades the lawn to the south, not the bays.
cannot_judge: Whether the island's bays are exempt from the No Stopping signs
